title: outreach velocity scratch
content:
2026-06-10 (WED) — afternoon sprint
Quick context: heavy inbound this week; focus on moving 4 mid-market opps to demo stage and re-engaging two Dedicated/Private prospects. Short bursts, measurable outcomes.

MORNING METRICS (so I remember):
- Calls made: 18 (goal 25)
- Emails sent: 34 (goal 40)
- New opps logged: 2
- Call-to-demo conversions: 1

PRIORITY ACCOUNTS (today) — order by time zone
1) VeloxFin (NY) — AE: me. Next step: push to technical discovery.
   - Notes: VP eng asked about Private deployment (VPC). Bring up hybrid routing + Dedicated burst option.
   - Script bullet: "If compliance is a blocker, we can show Private audit logs + KMS integration in a short tech walkthrough."
   - CTA: Book 30m tech deep-dive this week.

2) BrightCart (SF) — inbound MQL.
   - Notes: Interested in hosted API price predictability; ask about token volume patterns.
   - Experiment subject lines: A) "Quick question about BrightCart usage" B) "Short note on cost per chat at scale"

3) Atlas Health (London) — slow burner
   - Notes: Regulatory heavy. Emphasize Private (on-prem) and encryption keys.
   - TODO: send compliance one-pager + ask for SOC2 scope.

4) GameForge (SEA timezone) — follow-up from demo
   - Notes: Loved low-latency streaming. Concern: price per token for bursts. Pitch: batching + KV cache to reduce cost.
   - CTA: share a modeled cost estimate for 100k monthly queries.

FOLLOW-UPS (quick one-liners I can paste)
- VeloxFin: "Hey <name>, following up with a 30m slot for a short tech walkthrough — can I grab 2 options that work for you?"
- BrightCart: "Re: predictability — can you share a sample week of tokens? I can run a quick cost estimate."
- Atlas Health: "I can share our compliance pack and a short checklist for your security team — want it now or after discovery?"

CALL SCRIPT / FRAMEWORK (30–60s openers)
- Intro: "Hi NAME, Zeke from Redwood Inference — we help product teams serve LLMs predictably across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Quick Q: how often do you see latency spikes in production?"
- Qualify: "What's your peak concurrency? Do you need on-prem options for data residency?"
- Value: "We surface token-level cost and suggest batching/quantization to drop unit costs while holding quality."
- Close: "Would a 20–30m technical deep-dive be useful?"

EMAIL TEMPLATES (A/B test notes)
- Follow-up after demo (short): "Thanks for the demo time — sharing a 1-page cost model and a short checklist for next steps. When can we book a technical review?"
- Re-engage cold (curiosity): "We helped a similar team drop inference cost 38% via caching — want a quick example?"

EXPERIMENTS TO RUN
- A/B subject lines for BrightCart. Track open rate + reply in CRM.
- Send compliance pack to Atlas with optional calendar link vs. no link — see which gets faster response.

TODAY'S BLOCKERS / NOTES TO SELF
- Need updated compliance one-pager from product (pinged Riley) — follow up 2pm.
- Pricing calc template missing Dedicated burst row — update sheet or ask pricing-ops.
- Record short Loom of "how KV cache reduces cost" for GameForge reference.

TIMEBLOCKS (afternoon)
- 1:30–2:00 — VeloxFin outreach + calendar options
- 2:00–2:15 — follow Riley on compliance doc
- 2:30–3:30 — outbound call blitz (APAC friendly hours)
- 3:45–4:15 — cost modeling for GameForge
- 4:30–5:00 — CRM updates + note handoffs to solutions engineer

QUICK CRM NOTES (copy-paste friendly)
- VeloxFin: "Interested in Private deployment. Book tech deep-dive. Support asked about KMS/HSM."
- BrightCart: "Asking for token volume. Send cost estimate once received."

END-OF-DAY RETROSPECT (fill later)
- Wins: 
- Misses: 
- Learnings: 

RANDOM IDEAS / Snippets
- Short 1-slide summary: "When to choose Dedicated vs Private vs Hosted" (for demo decks)
- Quick checklist for security: SOC2, KMS, region restrictions, audit retention
- Template: "Cost model with Batching + KV cache + Quantization scenarios"

Notes to self: keep outreach casual, reference concrete numbers (latency, cost delta). If a prospect mentions "compliance" treat as high priority and escalate to solutions eng.

-- zeke
